items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I suppose they just asked him. Well, Billy is a very articulate guy and he would just do it. It added more prestige to the album in genera;. He had all kinds of positions in New York. He was on the board of this and that. He did a good job I thought.

ctx.x: Yeah that was a successful trio there. Yeah I still don’t know what its all about. I could never figure out billboard. (Laughs)
Billy Taylor wrote the liner notes for this album. How did that come about?

I suppose they just asked him. Well, Billy is a very articulate guy and he would just do it. It added more prestige to the album in genera;. He had all kinds of positions in New York. He was on the board of this and that. He did a good job I thought.
